name: narrowing-through-an-exported-declaration
description: An application, a closed world. A type of one package that another package reaches through its own package's exported declarations without naming it, as the type of a field, a slice element or a map value of what an exported function returns, a field promoted from an embedded type, the type of a parameter, of an exported variable, the element of an exported result type, or an exported field of an unexported type an exported function returns, is not reported as a candidate for unexporting, because that code holds values of the type. A type only an unexported field names, and one only its own file names, are reported.
